description: The lights of the hospital until the meeting with Kaufmann for the modern lighting (rt_lights, docs/RENDER.md section 10). By day: the sun through the windows of the ground floor and the doors. A roof over the whole grid keeps the sun to the windows.

sun.description: The overcast sun behind the fog: one fixed direction for the whole location (direction is the way the light travels, PS1 axes, y down). The fog dims it with the distance from the eye, so its shadows are only crisp near Harry and the fog keeps its own soft colour; light passes through the gaps of fences and leaves (alpha holes of the textures).

ceilings.description: The roof over the whole hospital: every cell draws a room whose walls end at about 3.6 m (the elevators draw no ceiling at all), so without it the sun fell into the rooms from above; no cell of the hospital is outdoors.

sky.description: The grey sky's light on surfaces open to it: the bounce rays that find nothing above see it.
